agentGuide: Microsoft Graph, base /v1.0, paths under /me. Mail: GET /me/mailFolders/inbox/messages?$top=10&$orderby=receivedDateTime desc&$select=subject,from,receivedDateTime,isRead,bodyPreview; search: GET /me/messages?$search="words"; one: GET /me/messages/<id> (body.content, HTML); send: POST /me/sendMail {"message": {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "Text", "content": "..."}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "..."}}]}}; reply: POST /me/messages/<id>/reply {"comment": "..."}. Calendar: GET /me/calendarView?startDateTime=<ISO>&endDateTime=<ISO>&$orderby=start/dateTime; create: POST /me/events {"subject": "...", "start": {"dateTime": "2026-10-02T10:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Paris"}, "end": {...}, "attendees": [...]}. OneDrive: GET /me/drive/root/children, search: GET /me/drive/root/search(q='words'), a file: GET /me/drive/items/<id>/content (save_as). To Do: GET /me/todo/lists, tasks: GET /me/todo/lists/<id>/tasks, add: POST ... {"title": "..."}. Contacts: GET /me/contacts?$search="name". Answers come in value[]; @odata.nextLink pages. A 403 means the scope was not granted at connection. Sending mail asks for confirmation.
